title: 1 million fps Slow Motion video of bullet impacts made by Werner Mehl from Kurzzeit
summary: Ten minutes of ultra-slow-motion footage of bullet impacts filmed at about one million frames per second by Werner Mehl of Kurzzeit. It includes hollow points in ballistics gel and impacts on glass.
why: Used as the go-to example of genuine one-million-fps footage and of bullet impact physics.

quote.text: At around 3:00 there is some nice bullet into bulletproof glass action.
